achievements.hint: Complete the tutorial.
Skip the tutorial.
Obtained upon entering the first tower: Tower of Repetition.
Obtained upon entering the second tower: Tower of Lamentation.
Obtained upon entering the third tower: Tower of Crushing Assembly.
Obtained upon entering the fourth tower: Tower of No Interval.
Enter the Tea House (the hub)

Defeat the final boss in the Tower of Repetition.
If you have bow and arrows, I recommend saving them for the next boss since this one is pretty easy.

Defeat the final boss in the Tower of Lamentation.
This boss has a high resistance to blunt damage so use something sharp.
My favorite method of dealing with them is to use arrows.

Defeat the first boss in the Tower of Crushing Assembly.
My favorite method of dealing with them is to use the flintlock from the tea house vendor and finish them with arrows. I hope you leveled some of your hp up tho, since this boss is a bit of an HP/resource check.

Defeat the final boss in the Tower of Crushing Assembly.
Low slash resistance, can easily be beaten (and stunlocked) with any of the reforged/repaired katanas and enough stamina.

Defeat the final boss in the Tower of No Interval.
Best way I found to defeat this boss is to rush to arena -> die, let the game revive you then use all of your arrows and ammo. It should be dead before running out of ammo but this strategy does make for an underwhelming final fight.
In the Tower of Repetition, you are able to find the Merchant at the cook's room.

In the Tower of Repetition, the Blacksmith will be trapped in the Pantry. To obtain the key to free them you must complete a side-quest involving the Merchant.
For more information about this, check the achievement "What Could go Wrong?".
In the Tower of Lamentation, you can find the Servant behind a door, screaming and crying. Kill all the enemies there to free her. Required to obtain the Brown Gem Wheel which is needed to progress.
In the Tower of Crushing Assembly, defeat the first boss and then interact with the blinking/flashing cocoon to free the priest.

In the Tower of Lamentation, find the Panty and interact with the door to speak with the Blacksmith. Agree to free him and then go to the merchant to ask him for the key.
He will ask you to steal a statue from a butsudan (buddha shrine) which will make an unkillable roaming monster spawn (but there's an achievement for "restoring the peace" after this so just do it). After getting the statue, deliver it to the merchant in exchange of the key to complete the quest. I recommend going to the pantry ASAP to rescue the blacksmith to get another achievement.

Check the achievement "What Could Go Wrong" and after you do that, come back here.
In the Tower of Crushing Assembly, after killing the first boss and going up the stairs, behind one of the doors in the hexagon shape room, you'll find a long hallway with a buddha statuette for the batsudan of Tower of Repetition.
So basically, with the statuette from the Tower of Crushing Assembly, head to the batsudan in the Tower of Repetition. This will also stop that unkillable enemy from spawning, but there isn't any other achievement tied to it so don't worry about that.

Obtained after finishing the King's Court Puzzle.
Required to finish the Tower of Repetition.

Obtained inside the Tea House. 
To make tea, interact with the table then add two scoops of matcha to the chawan (cup) then pour boiling water and whisk the tea.

There are 4 possible katanas you can use to repair the broken katana. You must choose only one per NG.
The first one is the Rusty Katana, found at the Tower of Repetition and has the lowest damage.
The second one is the Royal Katana, found at the Teahouse vendor and has high damage.
The third one is Kodoku Katana, found in the Tower of Lamentation. It deals poison damage.
The fourth one is in the Tower of Crushing Assembly. It deals bleed damage.

Which one should you choose? Honestly it depends if you're aiming to do NG+ or not because the developer's favorite (and highkey the best one) is the bleed katana, but that is obtained so far in the game that you'll have like an hour or two of playtime left. Maybe less if you know where to go. 

I went for the poison katana and regretted it because the third tower has mostly skeletons as enemies, which require blunt type damage to get killed.
There are no achievements for NG+ but there is new enemy variants and content so it really is up to you.
In the Tower of Lamentation, obtain a muddied weapon (red gem) and then bring it to the Servant in the teahouse.
Think well which weapon you want to upgrade as the upgrade materials are limited.
Think well which armour you want to upgrade as the upgrade materials are limited.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade one weapon or piece of armour
achievements.hint: Max upgrade level is +5.

achievements.description: Upgrade your health or stamina for the first time
achievements.hint: After you obtain a burning incense, use it at the shrines (where you save the game) to upgrade your stats.

achievements.description: Combine two items to make a new one
achievements.hint: Can be done as early as Tower of Repetition, but Tower of Lamentation and Tower of Crushing Assembly requires you to do this to progress so don't stress out.
